journey.name: Tag browse — a deck's tag chip opens every deck carrying it
journey.description:
Deck-detail tag chips were deliberately inert until global browse existed (#26): wiring them earlier would have traded a dead control for a dead end. This journey covers the wired behaviour. Needs a signed-in session (journey 01) and a published deck with at least one topical tag (journey 02).
Tag browse is its own destination rather than a jump into the Discover tab, because Discover is a page inside the HorizontalPager with no route to navigate to.

actions.action: Launch the Loopky app and verify the Home screen is shown
Tap the element with resource-id "tab_decks" in the bottom tab bar
Tap a deck tile that has at least one tag and verify deck detail opens
Verify a tag chip is shown below the deck title (rendered as "#tag")
Verify the tag-browse screen opens (resource-id: tag_browse_screen) with "#tag" in the top bar and a back button (resource-id: tag_browse_back)

Verify EITHER a grid of deck tiles (resource-id: tag_browse_tile) — which must include the deck you came from, since it carries the tag — OR the empty block (resource-id: tag_browse_empty) if the indexer has not ingested it yet

Confirm in logcat that the screen queried the indexer rather than filtering locally: look for "Loopky/TagBrowseVM: load('<tag>'): N decks, hasMore=…" and "Loopky/DiscoveryRepo: decksByTagGlobalPage('<tag>'): N/30 in K requests"
If the log reports hasMore=true, scroll to the foot of the grid and verify another page appends under the tiles already there, with no duplicates and no blank-and-repopulate (#321)

Turn the device radios off and reopen the tag chip. Verify the screen shows "You're offline" with a Retry (resource-id: tag_browse_error) and NOT the empty block — "No decks tagged X yet" is a claim about the network, and a device that never reached the indexer cannot make it. Turn the radios back on, tap Retry, and verify the grid loads.
Tap a deck tile in the grid and verify its deck detail opens
Navigate back twice and verify you return to tag browse and then to the original deck detail
Tap the element with resource-id "tag_browse_back" and verify you return to deck detail
